{{Quote|Attention ''Dessin{{'s}} Dagger''&mdash;power down and surrender or we will have to destroy you.|The pilot of a Republic Z-95 Headhunter, to the crew of the ''Dessin{{'s}} Dagger''|<ref name="Outward Bound (Living Force adventure)">{{LivingForce|Looking In: Outward Bound}}</ref>}}
'''''Dessin's Dagger''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] traveled to the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]] and there, the vessel's crew attempted to fit a device to a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]]. However, the freight was detected by local [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces and a trio of Republic [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] were sent to apprehend ''Dessin{{'s}} Dagger''. The freighter sped off in an attempt to flee the system, and the Z-95s followed it in hot pursuit. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance agents from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the Druckenwell system in a freighter, and their ship almost collided with the ''Dagger''. The three [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] approached the YT-1300 and in desperation, ''Dessin{{'s}} Dagger'' opened fire on them and destroyed one of the Z-95s.

{{RPG|[[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']]}}
The Heroes of Cularin decided to assist the two remaining Z-95s, and they helped the Republic forces to disable the ''Dessin{{'s}} Dagger'' and capture the freighter's crew.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
''Dessin{{'s}} Dagger'' was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]], and it appeared in [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']], a [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure that formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy|''Looking In'' trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign.
